See the history of Solidatus changes by release.
Title: Requirements
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-webfocus/requirements
Content: For both Agent mode and Standalone mode, a Solidatus instance running Solidatus 5.1 or greater is required.

For Agent mode, a Solidatus API token is required to register the agent in Solidatus.
For Standalone mode, a Solidatus API token is required to create and update models in Solidatus.

Title: Solidatus 5.5
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-2026.1/release-notes/release-notes-main/solidatus-v5-change-summary/5.5-release-notes
Content: Webhooks can issue notifications to external apps to keep track of model events. But they can also make Solidatus a central part of an automated workflow of discrete, connected systems.

With webhooks enabled, any time a model is updated or metadata is changed, Solidatus can automatically call the API of another system.

See Webhooks for more info.

This is a Beta feature and so is still in development. The feature will only be available if it has been switched on in your Solidatus configuration.
All feedback on current and potential capabilities is very welcome - please contact support@solidatus.com.
